name: Versatile Ring Slot
body:
Your proclivity for magical jewelry allows you to make use of rings on your toes as well as fingers.

Prerequisite(s): Ring Mudra; humanoid

Benefit(s): You may wear a third fully functional magic ring on one of your toes. The ring does not need to visible to be functional, but only one such ring may be active at any one time, in addition to those worn on the hands.

When worn in this way the ring takes the place of the Feet Wondrous item slot.

Normal: A character can only effectively wear two magic rings. A third magic ring doesn’t work if the wearer is already wearing two magic rings.

Affordable Arcana: Magic Rings, © 2017, d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Mark Thomas.
